name: Ialonus

attributes.attribute: a Continental Celtic god who ruled the cultivated fields
identified by the Romans with Mars, originally a fertility divinity

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ialonus is a Continental Celtic god. He is an obscure divinity. He ruled the cultivated fields. The Romans identified him with Mars. Mars is now described as a war god. Mars originally was a divinity of fertility.

okr.objective: Document the Continental Celtic god Ialonus and his Roman identification.
key_results: Record his rule over the cultivated fields.
Note the Roman identification with Mars.
Explain Mars as originally a fertility divinity.
